scenes.label: Opening Hook
scenes.audio: If you have friends in sales, don't let them see this video, otherwise their sales results will be too good.

scenes.label: Real Experience
scenes.audio: I once had a customer come to the showroom to see a Cayenne. He touched the steering wheel and said, 'I'll think about it.' Most salespeople would wait, but I didn't. On the third day, I sent him a message. I didn't ask how he was thinking; I said, 'You mentioned wanting to take your family out. This Sunday we have a family test drive; do you want to come?' On the seventh day, I shared a story about a father who just took delivery of his car.

scenes.label: Real Experience
scenes.audio: When he took delivery, his son sat in it and said, 'Dad, you look so cool!'

scenes.label: Real Experience
scenes.audio: On the fourteenth day, I invited him for coffee. We didn't talk about cars; we talked about problems in his industry.

scenes.label: Real Experience
scenes.audio: On the twenty-first day, he brought his wife. She was wearing red. As soon as she sat in the Cayenne, I said, 'We can choose a red interior. If you like it, we can go with that.'

scenes.label: Problem Solving
scenes.audio: As a result, the deal was closed that day. Look, I never pressured him once, but I planned every step in advance, just like navigation. You set a destination, but if you never look at traffic updates, you won't get there.

scenes.label: Problem Solving
scenes.audio: So you should go back and check those clients who are still 'considering.' Are they really considering, or are you just waiting for something?

scenes.label: Call to Action
scenes.audio: Comment with the word 'steps,' and I'll send you a sales step tracking sheet. Open it every day, and you'll know who to contact. I am Taixin, helping you understand human nature and close high-value deals.
